name: Skaha Bluffs main climbers' lot at the end of Smythe Road (upper lot)
basis: BC Parks page and a climbing wiki: park access is Lakeside Rd to Smythe Rd, gate, narrow road to the lower and upper parking lots at the end; no parking on the access road, overflow at bottom of Smythe Rd. The mapped Upper Parking/Lower Parking pair at 49.4310,-119.5636 matches by position; upper chosen as the lot nearest the crags. Evergreen-end crags have their own lot, not assigned.
